# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.3.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.3.0 | :x:                |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability within Zenith Audio, please do **NOT** open a public issue.

Instead, please send an advisory email directly to:
**Mohd Uwais Ghosi**: mohduwaisghosi@gmail.com

All reports will be investigated and addressed promptly.
